why: Two post-snapshot preprints on preprints.org claim to resolve Lehmer's totient conjecture: a Nov 2025 paper claiming a GRH-conditional near-resolution via a '2-adic closure' and 'bounded-catch framework', and a Jan 2026 paper titled 'A Short Proof the Lehmer's Totient Problem Has No Solutions'. Neither is on arXiv or clearly peer-reviewed, and no confirmation of correctness was found.
